tickets.title: Epic: contact export
tickets.description: Export contacts as CSV from the web app through a new API endpoint.

tickets.title: BE: GET /contacts/export returns CSV
tickets.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- GET /contacts/export answers 200 with text/csv
- one row per contact, columns id,name,email
- an empty list gives the header row only

AI Implementation Brief: follow src/handlers/list.js; add src/handlers/export.js and register it in src/app.js.

tickets.title: FE: Export button on the contacts page
tickets.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- an Export button on the contacts page downloads /contacts/export
- disabled while the download runs

Depends on DEMO-2.

tickets.title: BE: contacts list ignores the `q` filter
tickets.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- GET /contacts?q=ann returns only contacts whose name contains "ann" (case-insensitive)
- no q → every contact

tickets.title: BE: soft-delete contacts (data model)
tickets.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- DELETE /contacts/:id marks the contact deleted instead of removing it
- deleted contacts never appear in GET /contacts

Waits on DEMO-6 (the deletedAt column).

tickets.title: BE: add deletedAt to contacts
tickets.description: Add a nullable deletedAt column to the contacts store.

tickets.title: FE: contact avatars
tickets.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- each contact row shows an avatar with the person's initials
